{{Quote|My daughter was born Force sensitive and trained to be Sith. A great honor for our family. Unfortunately, my daughter's master is one Lord Grathan, a madman who is now disgraced in the eyes of the Dark Council.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Fraabaal]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vereta Fraabaal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] in the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|Apparently, my father isn't the only one living in a dream world. You can't kill a Sith, you silly!|Vereta Fraabaal, speaking to a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]]|audio=LivingInADreamWorld-VeretaFraabaal-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Born as a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] daughter of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Fraabaal]], Vereta was [[Sith training|trained]] as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], eventually becoming an apprentice of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Grathan]].<ref name="TOR" />

After Lord Grathan's decision to go rogue, Vereta remained loyal to him, one of many apprentices withstanding the siege of [[Lord Grathan's estate|his estate]] by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]].<ref name="TOR" />

Her father decided to hire a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], to kill her due to the political implications of Grathan's betrayal. The bounty hunter found her in [[Lord Grathan's estate]] and engaged the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] in a duel. Vereta was defeated, shocked that she could be beaten by a being who was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. She realized her folly in following Grathan's ways, and realized that her master had lied to her about her strength.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameDS}}
Still in disbelief that she could be defeated by a common bounty hunter, the hunter killed her.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Yes, redheaded. Like myself. And her mother...|Admiral Fraabaal|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Like many Sith, Vereta was very confident in her abilities in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. She was also very loyal to Grathan even after he went rogue. She believed that common bounty hunters couldn't kill Sith.<ref name="TOR" />

Despite her strength and confidence, she knew she wasn't invincible. She admitted that she could be killed by a more powerful Sith, a lucky Jedi, or an explosion, but not by a bounty hunter. When the Hunter defeated her, however, she was shocked and in denial at having been proven wrong, even as she was killed.<ref name="TOR" />

Vereta also considered imprisonment worse than death.<ref name="TOR" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|A more powerful Sith could kill me... or a really lucky Jedi, I suppose. Perhaps a bomb... but not some random bounty hunter.|Vereta Fraabaal, to the Hunter|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Being Sith and a Sorcerer, she was skilled in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], but her true power was with her skill in the Force, as she could use [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and even use [[Force lightning/Legends#Force storm|Force storm]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the light side option, the bounty hunter freezes Vereta in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and takes her to her father instead of killing her. This is an act the Sith apprentice sees as a fate worse than death. [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] will favor that option. Upon returning to Admiral Fraabaal, he is at first dismayed about having Verata brought to him alive though he thanks the hunter after expressing regret at trying to have her killed. He plans to have her locked until she comes to her senses.<ref name="TOR" />
